digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler rich-text codec and sync
propositions: Cloud descriptions and comments emit plain-text ADF paragraphs instead of structured ADF, causing Markdown formatting to appear as literal source in Jira
DC descriptions and comments lack native wiki markup rendering; Markdown headings, lists, code blocks, and emphasis appear as unformatted source text
Jira-authored rich text (panels, mentions, dates) reads as noise when pulled back into rebar due to lossy codec paths and lack of origin-gating preservation
Bidirectional sync causes echo loops and content erosion when the same field is edited in both systems without baseline tracking and change detection
DC wiki renderer must fall back safely when pandoc is absent, times out, or encounters pathological input without data loss
Two-way codec implementation must detect and flag concurrent edits (last-write-wins with conflict notification) instead of silently overwriting either local or remote changes
